C1 (linked to PF1) failed only in rollout 0 (tally 3/4) where used_oil_disposition was phrased "Accepted by contracted recycling service; release for pickup" instead of the "Contracted recycling service pickup" wording that passed in the other three rollouts, indicating an overly strict string match.
